Description: The revenue in the e-commerce market in the United States was modeled to amount to 1.18 trillion U.S. dollars in 2024. Following a continuous upward trend, the revenue has risen by 754.29 billion U.S. dollars since 2017. Between 2024 and 2029, the
revenue will rise by 655.91 billion U.S. dollars, continuing its consistent upward trajectory. Read more
Note(s): United States; 2017 to 2029
Source(s): Statista; Statista Market Insights

mobile.text:
Description: In 2024, around 12 percent of B2B sales in the United States were generated digitally. In 2028, the figure was expected to grow to around 14.3 percent. Whether the purchase transaction is finalized online or not, online channels have gained relevance in
the B2B customer journey. In the United States, two in three buyers use search engines for product discovery, and half of them browse online marketplaces. Read more
Note(s): United States; as of January 2025; *Forecast Read more
Source(s): eMarketer
